about: What this person told voters in each campaign since 2016: their campaign website as saved by the Wayback Machine just before election day (the homepage and the pages about where they stand), as text, and their campaign-season Bluesky and Threads posts. From scripts/collect-campaign-text.mjs; the promises in it are found by step 2.
name: Julia Letlow

pages.title: The Issues | Julia Letlow for Congress
pages.text:
## 100% Pro-Life
Julia has been a devout Christian her entire life and will always fight for the unborn.
## Putting LA-05 Back To Work
Julia will help create and bring jobs to our district. That includes opposing any increase to minimum wage.
## Protecting the 2nd Amendment
Julia is a staunch defender of our constitutional right to bear arms.
## Supporting Farmers, Loggers, & Ranchers
Julia will continue to promote and support our Agriculture and Logging industries.
## Standing Up For Oil and Gas
Louisiana is built on the Oil and Gas Industry. Julia will always fight to make sure we support and protect our Oil and Gas Industry.
## Supporting Our Veterans, Service Members, Law Enforcement, & First Responders
Julia will always support the men and women who protect our country at home and abroad.
## Rebuilding Our Infrastructure
Julia will work to ensure we get vital funding for our declining infrastructure, and to expand rural internet access.
## Supporting Education
From Early Childhood Education to Higher Ed, Julia believes education is a catalyst to elevate the district out of poverty.
## Protecting Election Integrity
Julia will always fight to ensure we have secure and safe elections.
## Protecting the 1st Amendment
Julia will always defend our constitutional right to freedom of speech, press, and assembly.
## Focus on Rural Development
Julia will be a strong advocate for our rural communities and fight to preserve our way of life.
## Supporting Our Seniors
Seniors are the greatest generation who paved the way for us, and we need to ensure they receive the best care in the world.
## Support Our Teachers & Public Employees
Julia will work to end the Windfall Elimination Provision (WEP) which unfairly penalizes retirees' Social Security benefits.

pages.title: Julia Letlow for Louisiana
pages.text: Julia Letlow is a Louisiana native, mother, educator, and conservative fighter who knows what it means to serve with faith, strength, and purpose. After the loss of her husband, Luke, Julia stepped forward to represent Louisiana’s 5th Congressional District, becoming the first Republican woman elected to Congress from Louisiana. In Congress, she has fought for parents, students, farmers, law enforcement, and Louisiana families, always guided by the same values that shaped her life: faith, family, service, and a deep love for our state. Now, with President Trump’s complete and total endorsement, Julia is running for the United States Senate to give Louisiana the strong conservative leadership our state deserves.

pages.title: JULIA'S PLAN | Julia Letlow
pages.text:
## Fighting for Louisiana Families
Louisiana deserves a Senator who will never forget where she came from, who she works for, and what is at stake for the next generation.
As a mother, educator, and conservative, Julia Letlow believes public service is about protecting our families, defending our values, growing our economy, and leaving our children a stronger America than the one we inherited.
In the Senate, Julia will work alongside President Trump to keep the border secure, lower costs for working families, assert American energy dominance, protect parents' rights, defend election integrity, and fight for the people and industries that make Louisiana strong.
From our farmers and fishermen to our veterans, energy workers, small businesses, and families struggling with rising costs, Julia's focus will always be on delivering results for Louisiana.
These are the issues Julia will fight for in the United States Senate:
## 1. Secure the Border and Deport Criminal Illegal Aliens
America is a nation of laws, and no nation can remain sovereign without secure borders.
Finish construction of the border wall
Deport criminal illegal aliens and gang members
Designate Mexican drug cartels as foreign terrorist organizations
Increase penalties for fentanyl trafficking
End taxpayer-funded benefits for illegal immigrants
Prevent illegal immigrants from being counted in the census
## 2. Lower Costs and Make Life Affordable Again
Louisiana families are working harder than ever, but too many feel like they're falling behind. Washington's spending addiction fueled inflation and made everyday life more expensive. It's time to bring costs down and help families keep more of what they earn.
Permanently extend the Trump tax cuts
Make the One Big Beautiful Bill’s no-tax-on-tips provision permanent
Make the One Big Beautiful Bill’s no-tax-on-overtime provision permanent
Expand and protect the Child Tax Credit for working families
Cut federal regulations that increase energy costs
Reduce government spending that fuels inflation
Lower healthcare and prescription drug costs
Increase American energy production to bring down gas and utility bills
## 3. Protect Parents' Rights and Put Families First
Parents know their children better than Washington bureaucrats. Families should have the final say in how their children are educated, raised, and protected.
Pass a national Parents' Bill of Rights
Require schools to notify parents about major decisions involving their children
Increase transparency in curriculum and classroom materials
Expand school choice and educational freedom
Protect parental access to school records
Stop federal interference in local education decisions
Keep political activism out of classrooms
Penalize education institutions that are hiding DEI programs
Provide parental warning labels on transgender content ​
## 4. Protect Women's Sports and Defend Common Sense
Girls deserve a level playing field, and parents deserve confidence that common sense still matters in America.
Keep biological men out of women's sports
Protect girls' locker rooms and private spaces
Codify protections for women's athletics under Title IX
Ban gender transition procedures for minors
Prevent federal agencies from redefining biological sex
Protect schools that uphold women's sports protections
## 5. Protect Election Integrity and Pass the Save America Act
Louisianans deserve confidence that every legal vote counts and that elections are secure, transparent, and trustworthy.
Pass President Trump's Save America Act
Require proof of citizenship to vote in federal elections
Strengthen voter ID requirements
Clean up voter rolls
Ban foreign interference in American elections
Increase election transparency and accountability
Oppose federal efforts to weaken election safeguards
## 6. Ban Congressional Insider Trading and Drain the Swamp
The American people are tired of politicians getting rich while families struggle. Members of Congress should serve the public, not their portfolios.
Ban Members of Congress from trading individual stocks
Strengthen financial disclosure requirements
Increase transparency in government spending
Codify DOGE spending cuts
Eliminate waste, fraud, and abuse across federal agencies
Reduce the size and scope of the federal bureaucracy
Strengthen oversight of unelected federal regulators
## 7. Secure American Energy Dominance
Louisiana powers America. We should be leading the world in energy production instead of begging foreign countries for resources we already have.
Expand oil and natural gas production
Accelerate LNG export approvals
Refill the Strategic Petroleum Reserve
Expand offshore energy development in the Gulf of America
Protect Louisiana refining and petrochemical jobs
Strengthen America's energy independence
## 8. Fight for Louisiana Farmers and Rural Communities
Louisiana farmers feed and fuel America. They deserve a Senator who understands the challenges facing agriculture and forestry and will always be their voice in Washington.
Deliver a strong Farm Bill
Protect crop insurance programs
Expand disaster assistance for farmers
Ban Chinese ownership of American farmland
Expand access to rural broadband
Protect family farms from excessive regulation
Strengthen agricultural research and extension programs
Expand access to credit for young farmers
## 9. Stand Up for Louisiana Fishermen and Seafood Producers
Louisiana's seafood industry is second to none. It is an invaluable part of our state’s culture, economy, and heritage. Washington should support our domestic industry, not make it harder to stay in business.
Crack down on unfair foreign seafood imports
Strengthen country-of-origin labeling requirements
Protect Gulf of America fisheries from federal overreach
Expand disaster assistance for fishermen
Protect working waterfronts and seafood processing jobs
## 10. Fix the Flood Insurance Crisis
Louisiana families should not be forced out of their homes because of skyrocketing flood insurance premiums and flawed federal policies.
Reform the National Flood Insurance Program
Increase transparency in FEMA risk-rating models
Roll back unfair premium increases
Expand mitigation funding for homeowners
Improve flood mapping accuracy
Protect homeowners from excessive federal mandates
Ensure Louisiana receives fair treatment in federal flood programs
## 11. Support Veterans and Military Families
The men and women who served our country deserve a government that keeps its promises long after they return home.
Reduce VA wait times
Expand access to community care
Improve mental health and PTSD services
Speed up disability claims processing
Protect military retirement benefits
Support military families and spouses
Strengthen missions at Barksdale, Fort Polk, and Belle Chasse
## 12. Protect Louisiana's Coast and Improve Disaster Recovery
Louisiana families know better than anyone that disasters don't end when the storm passes. Washington must do a better job helping communities recover while also investing in the infrastructure that protects our coast, waterways, and economy.
Reform FEMA and speed disaster assistance payments
Reduce federal red tape after hurricanes and natural disasters
Protect and expand GOMESA revenue sharing
Accelerate coastal restoration projects
Strengthen levee and flood protection systems
Expand dredging of navigation channels
Protect Mississippi River commerce
Improve hurricane resilience infrastructure
Support port modernization projects
Preserve Louisiana's working coast
## 13. Make America Healthy Again and Fix Our Food Supply
For too long, Washington has focused on treating illness instead of preventing it. Louisiana families deserve better information, healthier choices, and a food system that puts the health of our children first.
Increase transparency in food labeling
Work with Secretary Kennedy to implement the MAHA Agenda
Strengthen nutrition standards in federally funded programs
Support American farmers who produce healthy, nutritious foods
Expand research into chronic disease prevention
Promote healthier school meals and nutrition education
Reduce harmful additives and ingredients where supported by science
Encourage policies that make healthy food more affordable and accessible
Shift federal health policy toward prevention and long-term wellness
## 14. Rebuild America's Shipyards and Maritime Industry
Louisiana is ranked as the top maritime state in America, and our maritime and shipbuilding industries are a critical part of our state’s economy and the national security of our country. Julia will continue fighting every day for this important industry.
• Expand domestic shipbuilding capacity
• Protect the Jones Act
• Modernize Louisiana ports and shipyards
• Support maritime workforce development
• Increase Navy and Coast Guard ship procurement
• Expand defense manufacturing jobs
• Improve inland waterway infrastructure
• Grow America's maritime industrial base
## 15. Put Louisiana First
For too long, Washington politicians have focused on helping themselves instead of helping the people they represent. Julia believes a Senator's first responsibility is to fight for the people back home and deliver results that improve their lives.
Deliver first-class constituent services
Help Louisianans cut through federal red tape
Fight for Louisiana's fair share of federal resources
Stand up for local communities when Washington gets it wrong
Work directly with parish and local leaders
Support economic development and job creation across the state
Ensure every region of Louisiana has a seat at the table
Never lose touch with the people of Louisiana
